summary_1line: Tapati leaves Samvarana; after twelve days of devotion, sage Vasishtha secures her from Surya for the king and praises the power of a righteous priest.

image_candidates.scene_text: Tapati rises into the sky leaving the lovestruck King Samvarana collapsed on the forest floor.
Sage Vasishtha stands before the radiant sun-god Surya in the heavens, asking for Tapati’s hand for the king.
Tapati descends from the clouds like lightning as Vasishtha leads her toward the waiting King Samvarana.
